note: Apple Shortcuts action reference dataset and tooling.
scope: An Apple Shortcuts reference: an action dictionary mapping human-readable names to WFWorkflowActionIdentifier values across the built-in and third-party bundles, packaged with a small CLI to search it. A self-contained dataset and tool, useful on its own.
